risk_note: RV2-level (invite attribution: a landing registration binds the new member under the inviter). POST /v1/invites/landing-register goes live: fixed order 10004 → 20001 → 30408 → 42901 → 30401 (phone_hmac and IP) → 20002 / 20003 → already_registered → 44001 (phone blocklist via matchRegistration on the caller's transaction, hits recorded after rollback; then the same-IP landing registration limit counted in the new app.landing_registrations, migration 0053, under an advisory lock, closed window [now−3600 s, now]) → create and bind in one transaction (users h5_landing with parent_* and self_bind_used, two consent_records, growth conditional update + relation_change_logs source=landing, landing_registrations). Idempotent subject p:<phone_hmac>; every non-registered result rolls back to the flow's savepoint so a stored 3xxxx never commits the new account. Known: B1-03g's Redis same-IP new-registration counter is not undone on rollback; landing 44001 for the IP limit does not write risk_hits yet (TODO). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
